name: manual_e03157
claim: Classify peer delivery failures by boundary: TCP reachability, verified TLS, bearer authentication, endpoint latency, and independent receiver receipt are separate observations; a timeout or HTTP refusal alone does not prove a wrong token or a faulty proxy.

decisions.notes: Codex reviewer 2026-11-04 LAN recovery: short aggregate-status timeouts and stale receiver processes caused unsupported diagnoses; the fast authenticated inbox later returned 200 without credential or CA changes. See .agent/memory/working/2026-11-04-lan-recovery-byte-contract-and-stack-chronicle.md.
